content.title: WWE Hall of Fame 2026 Tonight: Start Time, Full Inductee List & How to Watch
content.text: WWE Hall of Fame 2026 start time, inductees, and how to watch tonight.Apr 17, 2026 10:54 AM EDTStephanie McMahon headlines the WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2026 in Las Vegas. Getty Images WrestleMania weekend is officially underway, and continues tonight with the WWE Hall of Fame in Las Vegas. WWE Hall of Fame 2026 starts at 12:00 a.m. ET / 9:00 p.m. PT and will stream live as part of the company’s packed schedule leading into WrestleMania 42. Here’s everything to know before the show. The Undertaker informs Stephanie McMahon of her induction at Wrestlepalooza in September.Getty Images Start Time, Location & How to Watch The WWE Hall of Fame will take place at Dolby Live, an indoor amphitheater on the Las Vegas Strip. Start Time: 12:00 a.m. ET / 9:00 p.m. PT Location: Las Vegas, Nevada U.S. Streaming: ESPN Unlimited International Streaming: WWE YouTube The ceremony follows the go-home episode of WWE SmackDown, making it a full night of WWE programming. A red carpet special is scheduled to begin 45 minutes before the ceremony (11:15 p.m. ET / 8:15 p.m. PT). WWE has also confirmed that The Miz and Michael Cole will serve as hosts. AJ Styles will be inducted after wrestling his last match at the 2026 Royal Rumble.Getty Images WWE has not yet announced who will deliver induction speeches for this year’s class, and it remains unclear whether the traditional format will be adjusted. Stephanie McMahon (Headliner) AJ Styles (Co-Headliner) Demolition Dennis Rodman (Celebrity Wing) Sid Vicious (Legacy Wing) Bad News Brown (Legacy Wing) Which McMahons Will Be There? It is likely that Linda McMahon will be in attendance to celebrate her daughter’s induction. She was in the front row last year when Triple H was inducted. Shane McMahon is also expected to be present with his family. However, it is highly unlikely that Vince McMahon will attend—either in the audience or backstage.
